memory_bridge: Make the four-sided enclosure a spring calendar and counting tray: 四月 supplies On シ, the bare numeral 四 supplies Kun よん, and four objects counted with the native counter are 四つ for Kun よっつ.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 四月（しがつ）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Paste 四月（しがつ） inside the four-sided April calendar; the opening character uses On シ.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 四（よん）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Write the bare number 四（よん） at the center of the four sides; the standalone numeral fixes Kun よん, “four.”

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 四つ（よっつ）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Put one flower on each side and count the set 四つ（よっつ）; the complete native counter word fixes Kun よっつ, “four.”
